name: Panels - Comic Reader
description:
Improve your comic reading experience with Panels. Enjoy reading your favorite titles in a clean and delightful interface, with plenty of customization and advanced features — fully DRM-free, with first-class support for OPDS, your own library, and your own files.

Key features:
- Universal Compatibility: Support for most common comic types: CBR, CBZ, CB7, PDF and comic ePUB (not text eBook). Support for multiple image formats, including WebP.
- Cross-Device Sync: Synchronize your reading progress across iPhone, iPad and Mac and resume reading exactly where you left off.
- Full iCloud Drive support: store your entire library on iCloud and access it from different devices.
- Library Organization: Effortlessly manage your comic library with intuitive tools for easy navigation, custom folder colors, logos and cover images.
* Themes: support for Light and Dark modes, and many others.
* Reading Presets: Choose from a multitude of reading presets or create your own, including horizontal, vertical, or panel-by-panel guided view.
- Right to Left reading (manga): read any comic with Panels.
* OPDS support: Stream, search and download comics from your OPDS compatible server (Komga, Kavita, Codex, Ubooquity and others).
* Secure your content: Keep files locked using a password or Face ID for your collections and files. Use Incognito mode to keep your reading sessions hidden.
* Live Text and Subject detection.
* Experimental Features: Access experimental features like panel-by-panel navigation.

Panels Store — DRM-free comics from independent creators:
- Browse and buy comics directly inside Panels, no extra apps or accounts.
- 100% DRM-free: every purchase is yours to keep, read offline and back up.
- Creators keep 80% of revenue, so your purchases directly support the people making the comics.
- Purchased issues are added to your library and sync across your devices automatically.

Native support for importing files from:
* iCloud Drive
* Dropbox
* Microsoft OneDrive
- Substack
* OPDS: Komga, Kavita, Codex and others
* Local network shared files and folders via SMB and Embedded web server
- iTunes
- External drives
- Airdrop
- Drag&Drop from other apps

Page Filters:
* Reduce Noise
* Increase Sharpness
* Reduce Moiré
* Crop Borders

* Require an active subscription or a one-time purchase.

• You may purchase an Auto-Renewing Subscription to unlock all the premium features while it\'s active; or a one-off purchase to unlock the current major version features forever.

• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase

• Read our privacy policy and terms of use: https://panels.app/privacy / https://panels.app/terms
release_notes:
New features
- Store wishlists: save comics to your own lists with the heart button on any comic, and browse your lists from the Store tab
- Set a maximum cache size in Manage Space, from 1 GB to 32 GB, and Panels clears the least recently used cached data to stay within it
- Choose, per library, whether thumbnails are saved in the library's folders or kept inside Panels (Manage Space → your library)

Improvements
- The Store home now shows its sections in the order our editors arranged them
- "See all" in the Store now opens the exact collection you were looking at, including Top Picks
- Comic pages in the Store now suggest more from the same series and related categories, with quick links to the series' first and latest issues
- Panels View opens faster on comics you've read before, reusing panels it already detected instead of detecting them again
- Manage Space now names each streamed comic in Streamed Pages and shows its pages in reading order

Fixes
- Fixed tapping a comic in the Files app extracting it into a folder instead of offering to open it in Panels
- Fixed "next comic" not working in libraries sorted by Last Read or Reading Progress
- Fixed the continuous reader sometimes saving the wrong page after rotating the device, or after jumping to a page from the side thumbnails on iPad
- Fixed streamed pages (OPDS and Panels Store) sometimes staying on the loading placeholder, page thumbnails showing a false error icon, and stutter while swiping
- Fixed the pages you read in the first sitting of a comic not counting towards your reading stats
- Fixed Import Staging in Manage Space growing over time and not being deletable
- Fixed Store links opening comics and series without their cover or banner
- Fixed the Store sometimes showing a small thumbnail in place of a comic's full-size cover or banner
- Fixed the Panels Plus screen sometimes getting stuck on "Loading products…" with iCloud libraries, and showing empty plans or a failed restore with no way to retry
- Fixed covers being regenerated on every visit in library folders where Panels can't save thumbnails, such as some external drives
- Fixed Live Text and translations appearing in the wrong place on the page after toggling Remove borders or changing the rendering mode
- Fixed Store wishlists, Manage Space and some library settings appearing in English, or with a placeholder instead of the comic count, in other languages
